Ngasekupheleni kuka-2022, amazwe amaningi abike izimpawu eziyingxenye zokubuyiselwa kwensizakalo, kufaka phakathi ezinsizakalweni zezempilo yezocansi, ukuzala, umama, usana, ingane nentsha; ukudla okunomsoco; ukugoma; izifo ezithathelwanayo (kufaka phakathi umalaleveva, i-HIV, i-TB, nezinye izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi); izifo ezingathinteki ezishisayo; izifo ezingathinteki; ukuphathwa kwezifo zengqondo, zezinzwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa; ukunakekelwa kwabantu asebekhulile; kanye nokunakekelwa kwendabuko kanye / noma okuhambisanayo.

Lo mbiko ushicilelwe yizinhlangano ezigcina i-SDG 7, i-International Energy Agency (IEA), i-International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), i-United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), iBhange Lomhlaba, kanye ne-World Health Organization (WHO) futhi ihlose ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ngedeshibhodi yomhlaba wonke yokubhalisa inqubekela phambili ekufinyeleleni kwamandla, ukusebenza kahle kwamandla, amandla avuselelekayo kanye nokubambisana kwamazwe omhlaba ukuqhubekisela phambili i-SDG 7.

Iqaphela izehlakalo zakamuva zemithi engcolisiwe etholakala ezimakethe ezahlukahlukene kanye nokufa okuhlobene okungagwemeka, amazwe angamalungu agcizelele ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuthuthukisa ikhono lawo lokuvimbela, ukuthola nokuphendula emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha engekho ezingeni elifanele futhi engamanga ngokufinyelela kubuchwepheshe obufanele, kufaka phakathi izikhungo zokuhlola zaselabhorethri, kanye nokuqapha okuthuthukisiwe ezimakethe ezingekho emthethweni nasekukhangiseni, kanye nokuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo yezokwelapha ku-inthanethi.

Emcimbini obanzi owawubanjelwe ukubuyekeza inqubekela phambili ngokuhambisana ne-WHO road map for neglected tropical diseases 2021-2030 nokwakha ukuqonda okungcono ngemisebenzi ye-NTD yomhlaba wonke kusuka kuzo zombili izindlela ezithile zezifo kanye nemibono ehlanganisiwe, abalingani, abanikeli, abalingani bezobuchwepheshe, izikhungo kanye nabamele amazwe baqinise ukuzibophezela kwabo ekufezeni umgomo onamandla: umhlaba ongenazo izifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe ngo-2030.

UMkhandlu, owasungulwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ngoNovemba 2020 ekuphenduleni ubhadane lwe-COVID-19, futhi owawuholwa nguProfesa Mariana Mazzucato, uchithe leyo minyaka emibili edlule ecabanga kabusha ngomnotho ngokombono wezempilo wabo bonke, futhi egqugquzela ngamandla isimiso sokuthi impilo yabantu neyomhlaba kufanele ibe semqoka endleleni esakha ngayo izinhlelo nezinqubomgomo zethu zenhlalo, ezempilo nezomnotho.

I-World Health Organization (WHO) kanye ne-United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) kanye ne-PMNCH - umfelandawonye omkhulu kunayo yonke emhlabeni wabesifazane, izingane kanye nentsha - zenza isimemezelo "sokuphuthuma okuthule" kokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, okungakaqashelwa kahle ngobukhulu nobunzima bako, okuvimbela intuthuko ekuthuthukiseni impilo nokusinda kwezingane.

Izindaba ezinhle ziwukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kungavinjelwa ngokungenelela okusekela abazali nabanakekeli, ukukhuthaza izindinganiso namagugu okungabi nodlame, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo nokuqeqeshwa kwamakhono okuphila, ukuqinisa imali engenayo yemindeni nokuvikeleka kwezomnotho, ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokuphendula nezokusekela ezisezingeni eliphakeme, ukudala nokugcina izindawo eziphephile zezingane, nokusebenzisa nokuphoqelela imithetho elwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane.

Ngale njongo, lolu hlelo lusebenzisana nochwepheshe kanye nezinhlangano ezikhethekile ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ebalulekile yocwaningo, kutholakale futhi kulinganiswe izingozi zezempilo ezivela emisebeni ye-UV, kuthuthukiswe izibikezelo ezinokwethenjelwa zezempilo nemiphumela yezinguquko ekuchayekeni kwe-UV ekunciphiseni kwe-ozone ye-stratosphere, futhi kuthuthukiswe izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuqapha ushintsho emiphumeleni yezempilo ebangelwa yi-UV ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

Njengoba iyingxenye yoHlelo Lwezimo Eziphuthumayo Lwezempilo lwe-WHO, i-WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence (i-WHO Pandemic Hub), yenza kube lula ukubambisana komhlaba wonke kwabalingani abavela emikhakheni eminingi okusekela amazwe nabathintekayo ukubhekana nezingozi zesikhathi esizayo zobhubhane nezifo eziwumshayabhuqe ngokufinyelela okungcono kwedatha, amakhono angcono okuhlaziya, namathuluzi angcono nokuqonda kokwenza izinqumo.

Kukhona izindleko ezingokwengqondo, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane nemindeni yabo, njengokucindezeleka komama, imiphumela yezezimali kanye nemiphumela yezomnotho, kanye nokucwaswa kanye nokungavunyelwe. Ngo-2014, i-World Health Assembly yasekela i-Every Newborn Action Plan (ENAP), okubandakanya umgomo womhlaba wonke wezingane ezizalwe zifile eziyi-12 noma ngaphansi kwesithathu (ngasekupheleni) kwabangu-1 000 abazalwa ezweni ngalinye ngo-2030.

Ukubhekana nezinselelo, ukuphendula izidingo ezikhonjwe ngamazwe angamalungu nokwakha emsebenzini owenziwe ngaphansi kwesu le-WHO lokwelapha kwendabuko: 2002-2005, isu elibuyekeziwe lesikhathi sika-2014-2023 linikeza ukunakwa okwengeziwe kunelokuqala ekubekeni phambili izinsizakalo zezempilo nezinhlelo, kufaka phakathi imikhiqizo, imikhuba kanye nabasebenzi bezokwelapha bendabuko.

Ukutshala imali ku-PHC kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke lezo zidingo ziyabonwa, zibekwe phambili futhi zibhekwane nazo ngendlela ehlanganisiwe; ukuthi kunabasebenzi bezempilo nokunakekelwa abaqinile nabahlomele kahle; nokuthi yonke imikhakha yomphakathi inikela ekubhekaneni nezici zemvelo nezenhlalo nezomnotho ezithinta impilo nenhlalakahle, kufaka phakathi ukulungiselela, ukuphendula nokululama ezimweni eziphuthumayo.

Izindinganiso zokusiza abantu ezijulile ze-UAE zisho ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi iyaqhubeka nokuxhumana nomhlaba ngokuzinikela kwayo okuqinile nokungapheli ekuqiniseni ukuthula, ukuphepha nokuzinza, hhayi esifundeni kuphela, kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke, ngenkathi kanye nabalingani bayo kanye nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba, izwe liqhubeka nokusiza abantu baseSudan ngezikhathi zobunzima.

Ukutholakala kwe-morphine ukuze isetshenziswe kwezokwelapha kuthonywa yizinto eziningi ezisebenzisanayo ezibandakanya izinto ezivumela ukubusa okuhle, izinqubo zokuthengwa kwempahla ezinokwethenjelwa/ezisebenza kahle, ukutholakala kwemithombo kanye nemisebenzi yokwakha amakhono, kanye nezingqinamba ezihlobene nomthetho nezinqubomgomo ezivimbela ngokweqile, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo okunganele, kanye nesimo sengqondo nokubona okungalungile.

Lo mbiko, osethwe namuhla ngokuhambisana noMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba Wonke wamashumi ayisikhombisa nesithupha, onesihloko esithi "Impilo Yabo Bonke: Ukuguqula Umnotho Ukuze Kufezwe Okubalulekile" (https://www.who.int/groups/who-council-on-the-economics-of-health-for-all), unikeza uhlaka olusha olwakhiwe ezinsikeni ezine ezingenhla, kanye nezincomo ezithile ngaphansi kwesinye nesinye - ezithathwe emsebenzini wangaphambilini woMkhandlu.

Indlela ye-WHO yokunakekela impilo yasemadolobheni igxile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lomoya, amanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle, nezinye izinto ezinquma imvelo; ukuhlelwa kwedolobha okunempilo; izindawo ezinempilo nezingenakho ukubhema; ukuhamba okuphephile nokunempilo; ukuvimbela udlame nokulimala; ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokudla okunempilo nokudla; ukuphathwa kwemvelo kwezifo ezithwalwa amagciwane; nokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo emadolobheni.

Uhlu lwezinto ezithengwa kakhulu lusanda kubuyekezwa eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba ngoMeyi ukuze luhlanganise ukuvimbela okwesibili umkhuhlane we-rheumatic, ukuphathwa okusheshayo nokwesikhathi eside kwesifuba somoya kanye nesifo samaphaphu esingamahlalakhona kanye nokungenelela okuningana kokwelashwa komdlavuza wesibeletho, webele, we-colorectal, wesibindi kanye nomdlavuza wezingane, kanye nokwelashwa okuphelele komdlavuza kulabo abaphila ne-HIV.

Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Li uzobheka imizamo yeNhlangano yokukhuthaza impilo enhle nenhlalakahle ngokungenelela okuhlobene nezici zemvelo, ezenhlalo nezomnotho zezempilo, kubandakanya ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukulawulwa kukagwayi, ukuphepha kwamakhemikhali, ukuphepha emigwaqweni, izinhlelo zokudla nokudla okunomsoco, ukuzivocavoca umzimba, ukungcoliswa komoya nemisebe, ngokusebenzisa indlela ye-One Health.

Amasu kanye nezenzo zomhlaba wonke emikhakheni efana nempilo yabesifazane, yezingane kanye nentsha, ukuvuselelwa, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo komphakathi kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, imithi yendabuko, ukuvimbela nokulawula izifo ezithathelwanayo, imithi engekho ezingeni elifanele kanye nemithi engamanga, impilo yababaleki kanye nabafuduki, izifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo, impilo yengqondo, izinto ezinquma umphakathi, ukudla okunempilo kanye nokukhubazeka;

"Ngokusebenza ngokubambisana - ohulumeni, abanikeli, umkhakha wangasese, umphakathi, abazali, kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo - singakwazi ukuxwayisa ngalolu "simo esiphuthumayo esingazwakali", futhi silethe imizamo yokuvimbela nokunakekela ngaphambi kwesikhathi phambili emizamweni kazwelonke yezempilo nentuthuko, ukwakha ingcebo yabantu ngokusekela imindeni, imiphakathi kanye nezomnotho yonke indawo.

Ngemuva kweminyaka yezigameko eziphindaphindwayo ze-trachoma esebenzayo, ingaphakathi le-eyelid lingaba nezibazi ezinzima kakhulu (i-trachomatous conjunctival scarring) kangangokuthi liguquke libheke ngaphakathi futhi libangele ukuthi izinwele zamehlo zihlabelele ebholeni le-amehlo (i-trachomatous trichiasis), okuholela ebuhlungwini obungapheli nasekungabekezelelani kokukhanya; lokhu kanye nezinye izinguquko zamehlo kungaholela ekubeni ne-trachoma.

Ehlanganiswe nguMqondisi-Jikelele we-World Health Organization (WHO), uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noDkt Joe Phaahla, uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo noNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezezimboni, uMnuz Ebrahim Patel waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezikhulu ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezivela emazweni anikela ngezimali, lo mhlangano oyingqayizivele ubukeze inqubekela phambili kusukela i-WHO ne-Medicines Patent Pool (MPP) baqala ngoJuni 2021.

Umnqobi womklomelo we-United Arab Emirates Health Foundation Prize2023: uDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre wasePhilippinesNgaphezu kokuba ngudokotela odumile nomcwaningi, uDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre ungummeli oshisekayo wokuncelisa ibele kuphela futhi ungumsunguli weKalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Impilo kamama nengane) - inhlangano engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni yasePhilippines.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi esingezimpawu sezinsuku eziyi-1120 kufika ku-15% weziguli zihlangabezana nesigaba sesibili sesifo esibonakala ngomkhuhlane ovame ukudlula ku-40 °C kanye nezimpawu zokubandakanyeka kwesistimu yezinzwa emaphakathi, njenge-meningitis (isib. umkhuhlane, ikhanda, nentamo eqinile), i-encephalitis (isib. ukozela, ukudideka, nokuphazamiseka kwemizwa), i-myelitis noma i-radiculitis.

Lesi senzakalo siphinde sibe yingqopha-mlando ebalulekile yoHlelo ngokwethulwa kwesikhungo se-mRNA technology Hub e-Afrigen eKapa phambi kukaDkt Tedros noDkt Matshidiso Moeti uMqondisi Wesifunda we-WHO e-Afrika, uCharles Gore uMqondisi Omkhulu we-MPP kanye noNgqongqoshe abahloniphekile ababambe iqhaza emcimbini wokunqamula iribhoni e-Afrigen.

Izimbangela ezinkulu zokuzalwa kwengane efile zihlanganisa izinkinga ezihlobene nokukhulelwa nokubeletha, ukukhulelwa isikhathi eside, izifo ezithathelwanayo zomama ezifana nomalaleveva, isifo sofuba kanye ne-HIV, izimo zomama ikakhulukazi umfutho wegazi ophakeme, nesifo sikashukela, kanye nokunciphisa ukukhula kwengane (lapho ingane engakazalwa ingakwazi ukufinyelela amandla ayo okukhula futhi ngenxa yalokho incane kunalokho okufanele ibe yikho).

Izinhloso zalo mhlangano ukubuyekeza inqubekela phambili yohlelo lwe-WHO lokulwa nezifo ezishisayo ezinganakwa ngo-2021 kuya ku-2030 kanye nokwakha ukuqonda okungcono ngemisebenzi ye-NTD yomhlaba wonke ngokombono oqondene nezifo kanye nangombono ohlanganisa zonke izici, kanye nokuzibandakanya ezingxoxweni ezibanzi ezizungeze umbono we-WHO eyodwa yokuletha uhlelo olulodwa lwe-NTD lomhlaba wonke.

Lezi zihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokwelapha ngocingo, ukukhuthazwa kokunakekelwa kwasekhaya noma ukungenelela kokuzinakekela, izindlela zokuqinisa ukutholakala kwabasebenzi bezempilo, amakhono kanye nezindlela zokusekela, izinto ezintsha ekuthengeni nasekuhlinzekeni imithi nezinto ezidingekayo, ukuxhumana okuvamile nomphakathi, kanye nobambiswano nabahlinzeki bomkhakha wangasese.

Inikeza uhla olubanzi lwezinhlelo nemisebenzi ethuthukisa ukukhuthazwa kwezempilo kubantu asebekhulile, kusukela ekuqondeni kangcono izimbangela zokugula nokufa ngokusebenzisa ukuqapha kuzwelonke kwezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo, ucwaningo, amarekhodi okufa kanye nocwaningo, kuya ezinhlelweni ezenzelwe ukukhuthaza ulwazi lwezempilo kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisekelwe ebufakazini.

Amazwe aveze isidingo sokusekelwa yi-WHO ukubhekana nezinselelo ezisele esimweni se-COVID-19 nangaphezulu, ngokuvamile ezihlobene nokuqiniswa kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ukwakha amakhono okuqapha izinsizakalo zezempilo, ukuklama amamodeli okunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, ukuphathwa, inqubomgomo nokuhlela kanye nokuhlelwa kwezezimali nokuxhaswa ngezimali.

Ngokulandela izinkomba zabo ezivela kulezi zinguquko ezintathu ezibalulekile ezikhuthazwe kule mephu yomgwaqo - ukuzibophezela okukhulu kwezwe, ukukala imiphumela hhayi inqubo, kanye nokuzibophezela emisebenzini ehlukahlukene kanye nokubambisana ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle okukhulu - izingxoxo zazinengqondo, zinombono ocacile futhi zigcwele nesidingo sokulingana kwezempilo nobulungiswa bokubhekana nama-NTDs.

Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Salomon uzobheka uhla olubanzi lwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezihlanganisa i-HIV, i-viral hepatitis, izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, isifo sofuba, umalaleveva, izifo eziwumshayabhuqe ezinganakwa, impilo yengqondo, ukuphazamiseka kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa, kanye nezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo ezifana nesifo senhliziyo, isifo sikashukela, izifo zokuphefumula ezingalapheki kanye nomdlavuza.

Izinyanga eziholela kulezi zenzakalo ezibalulekile zinikeza ithuba lokuthi amazwe angamalungu kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe amaningi zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuthola izindlela zokusebenzisa izincomo nokulungiselela indawo yokusebenzisa ngokugcwele ukubambisana okuqinile nokusheshisa inqubekela phambili ekufezeni i-SDG ezihlobene nezempilo engxenyeni yesibili yesikhathi se-SDG.

Ukubuyiselwa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile kubalulekile ngoba ukuphazamiseka - okubandakanya izinsizakalo zokukhuthaza impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukuxilonga, ukwelashwa, ukuvuselelwa kanye nokudambisa - kungaba nemiphumela emibi kakhulu empilweni yabantu nasezingeni lomuntu ngamunye kunobhubhane ngokwalo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasengozini.

I-Xenotransplantation, isilwane kuya kumuntu, echazwa njengamaseli aphilayo, izicubu noma izitho zemvelaphi yezilwane kanye noketshezi lomzimba womuntu, amaseli, izicubu noma izitho ezine-ex vivo nalezi zinto eziphilayo, i-xenogeneic, inamandla okuba enye indlela yezinto zemvelaphi yomuntu futhi igcwalise ukushoda kwempahla yabantu yokufakelwa.

Abakhiqizi bemithi yokugoma abaningi baye basungula imithi yokugoma ye-COVID-19 enezakhi ze-antigenic ezibuyekeziwe; lokhu kufaka phakathi imithi yokugoma eminingana esekelwe ku-mRNA ene-Omicron yangaphambilini, ngaphezu kwegciwane lenkomba (okungukuthi, i-index virus + BA.1 noma i-BA.4/5), egunyazwe ukusetshenziswa okuphuthumayo yiziphathimandla ezilawulayo.

I-MPOWER yakha ikhono lamazwe lokusebenzisa izinyathelo eziyisithupha zokunciphisa ukufunwa kwemikhiqizo kagwayi: ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi nezinqubomgomo zokuvimbela, ukuvikela abantu ekusebenziseni ugwayi, ukunikeza usizo lokuyeka ukusebenzisa ugwayi, ukuxwayisa ngezingozi zikagwayi, ukuphoqelela ukuvinjelwa kokukhangisa ngogwayi, ukukhuthaza nokuxhasa kanye nokwenyusa izintela zikagwayi.

Isizukulwane sethu siye sabona intuthuko enkulu kwezesayensi nakwezobuchwepheshe kunazo zonke izizukulwane ezidlule ndawonye futhi sabona izinguquko eziningana ezingokwengqondo, ezobuchwepheshe, ezokwelapha nezenhlalo ezaziholwa inguquko yokuvimbela inzalo futhi zalandelwa intuthuko kwezempilo yokuzala, izinto ezintsha zezempilo kanye namalungelo nokulingana ngokobulili.

I-2030 Agenda for SDGs Umsebenzi we-WHO uhambisana nenhloso 3.8 ye-Sustainable Development Goals (SDG), egxile ekufezeni ukunakekelwa kwezempilo komhlaba wonke, kubandakanya ukuvikelwa kwengozi yezezimali, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezisezingeni eliphakeme kanye nokufinyelela emithini nemithi yokugoma ebalulekile ephephile, esebenzayo, esezingeni eliphezulu futhi engabizi kuwo wonke umuntu.

Umbiko omusha we-International Energy Agency (IEA), i-International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), i-United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), iBhange Lomhlaba, kanye ne-World Health Organization (WHO), okhishwe namuhla, uthola ukuthi umhlaba awukho endleleni yokufeza iSithembiso Sokuthuthukiswa Okuqhubekayo (SDG) 7 samandla ngo-2030.

UHulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea unikeza uhla olukhulu lwezikhungo zokuqeqesha zikazwelonke nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa lonke uhla lokukhiqizwa kwezinto eziphilayo futhi ukhulisa imisebenzi yayo ukuze kuhlaliswe abaqeqeshwayo abaningi abavela kwamanye amazwe ngokwakhiwa kwe-Global Bio Education Campus ezokwethulwa ngo-2025.

Phakathi nomhlangano wezinsuku ezinhlanu, ababambiqhaza bazokwabelana ngenqubekela phambili futhi baxoxe ngezinto ezibalulekile ezenza ukuqina koHlelo njengezindaba zempahla yengqondo kanye nezici zokulawula, kanye nesayensi yezobuchwepheshe be-mRNA kanye nezicelo ezibalulekile ezihlobene nama-LMICs kwezinye izindawo zezifo ezifana ne-HIV nesifo sofuba.

Ngemuva kweminyaka emithathu yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19, izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni seziqalile ukukhombisa izimpawu zokuqala ezinkulu zokuvuselelwa kohlelo lwezempilo, ngokusho kombiko wesikhashana we-WHO mayelana "nomjikelezo wesine wocwaningo lomhlaba wonke lokuphila kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lwe-COVID-19: Novemba 2022-Januwari 2023".

I-UAE igxile kakhulu ekuhlinzekeni amaqembu asengozini kakhulu athintwe yisimo saseSudan, ikakhulukazi abagulayo, izingane, asebekhulile, nabesifazane abasengozini enkulu ngenxa yezingxabano eziqhubekayo - futhi lezi zindiza zosizo zizobhekana ngqo nezikhala eziphuthumayo kakhulu ekunikezelweni kwezokwelapha nokudla.

I-WHO road map for neglected tropical diseases 20212030 iyisisekelo esibanzi esichaza imigomo, izindlela zokuhambisana nezinhloso zentuthuko ezinzile kanye nezinye izinhlelo zomhlaba wonke futhi icela ukuguqulwa kwamasu ezindlela ze-NTD ngenhloso yokuqeda ubhubhane lwezifo ezishisayo ezinganakwa ngo-2030.

Ochwepheshe bokunikela nokufakelwa kwezitho zomzimba abavela kuzo zonke izifunda, ngokusebenzisa izinhlangano nezikhungo zabo eziningi, bayasisekela iSimemezelo Sase-Istanbul mayelana nokushushumbiswa kwezitho zomzimba kanye nokuvakasha kokufakelwa kwezitho zomzimba okwenziwa ngaphansi kobuholi beTransplantation Society kanye ne-International Society of Nephrology ngoMeyi 2008.

Noma kunjalo, amazwe amaningi (ama-80% amazwe angu-83 aphendulile) abike okungenani inkinga eyodwa yokwandisa ukufinyelela kumathuluzi abalulekile e-COVID-19 (isib. ukuxilongwa kwe-COVID-19, ukwelashwa, imithi yokugoma kanye nemishini yokuzivikela - i-PPE), kanti izinkinga zabasebenzi bezempilo kanye nokuntuleka kwezimali kumelela izithiyo ezivame kakhulu.

Ucwaningo lwesine lulandela ucwaningo lwe-WHO lwangaphambilini lwango-2020 nango-2021: Umjikelezo 1 (Meyi-Septhemba 2020), Umjikelezo 2 (Januwari-Mashi 2021), noMjikelezo 3 (Novemba-Disemba 2021) owabonisa ukuthi ubhubhane luthinta kangakanani ukuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile nokuthi amazwe athatha kanjani izinyathelo.

IZizwe Ezihlangene zichaza udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngokuthi "noma yisiphi isenzo sodlame oluhlobene nobulili oluholela, noma okungenzeka luholele, ekulimaleni noma ekuhluphekeni ngokomzimba, ngokobulili, noma ngokwengqondo kwabesifazane, kuhlanganise nokusongelwa ngezenzo ezinjalo, ukuphoqelelwa noma ukuphucwa inkululeko ngokungemthetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kwenzeka emphakathini noma ekuphileni kwangasese.

Njengoba ukuthengwa kwezinto zomuntu zokufakelwa kusuka kubanikeli abafile noma abaphilayo kanye nokufakelwa kwe-allogeneic okulandelayo kungabangela izingozi zokuziphatha nezokuphepha kubo bobabili abamukeli kanye nabanikeli, iziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele zenze ukulawula okuqinile nokuqapha okusebenzayo ukuze zibavikele.

Ngokubambisana nabanye abalingani be-Alliance, i-WHO isekela ukusetshenziswa kweqhinga le-SAFE emazweni kanye nokuqiniswa kwamandla kazwelonke ngokuhlola ubhubhane, ukuqapha, ukuqapha, ukuhlola amaphrojekthi kanye nokuqoqwa kwemithombo okufaka isandla ekuqedeni i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi.

Izizwe ezingamalungu zivumile ukwamukela "Uhlaka Lomhlaba Wonke Lokuhlanganisa Inhlalakahle Empilweni Yomphakathi Kusetshenziswa Indlela Yokukhuthaza Impilo", oluzama ukunika bonke abantu amandla okuchuma futhi bafinyelele amandla abo aphelele empilweni yomzimba nengqondo kukho konke ukuphila kwabo kanye nasezizukulwaneni.

Ku-neurocysticercosis, njengoba ukubhujiswa kwama-cysts kungaholela ekuphenduleni kokuvuvukala, ukwelashwa okukhethekile kwesifo esisebenzayo kuyadingeka futhi kungafaka izifundo ezinde ezinamazinga aphezulu e-anthelmintic, kanye nokwelashwa okusekelayo ngama-corticosteroids kanye / noma imithi elwa nesifo sokuwa, futhi mhlawumbe nokuhlinzwa.

Eminyakeni yamuva, izinsiza zamazwe ngamazwe zamalungelo abantu ziye zasetshenziswa kakhulu ukusekela nokuthuthukisa izimangalo zomthetho zabantu ngabanye kanye nemiphakathi yonke ukuze ohulumeni bezwe baqinisekise ukuhlonishwa, ukuvikelwa nokugcwaliseka kwamalungelo abo ezempilo yezocansi nokuzala (Cook et al., 2003).

Ukwethulwa kwalolu hlelo kwenzeka ngosuku lokugcina lwemihlangano nabantu abangaphezu kuka-120 abamele amazwe angamalungu, abalingani, kanye noNobhala we-WHO, ukuchaza indlela eya phambili ye-PRET, kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa komgudu wokusebenzisa umhlaba wonke wokulungela ubhubhane lwezifo zokuphefumula.

NgoMeyi 27, uMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba Wonke wamashumi ayisikhombisa nesithupha wagunyaza isinqumo sokwenza ukubuyekezwa okuzimele kweMishini Yezwe Yamalungu (i-MSM) yezigameko, imithi engekho ezingeni elifanele kanye nemithi engamanga, kuqiniswa isimemo sikaMqondisi-Jikelele sikaJanuwari 2023 sokwanda kokuqapha nokuthatha izinyathelo kule ndawo ebalulekile.

Ukuzinakekela kuyikhono labantu ngabanye, imindeni kanye nemiphakathi lokuthuthukisa impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukugcina impilo, nokubhekana nokugula nokukhubazeka ngokusekelwa noma ngaphandle kosizo lwabasebenzi bezempilo. Okwamanje abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.6 - isigamu somhlaba - abanakho ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ezibalulekile.

Endimeni yakhe yamanje, uDkt Al Jalahma uhole izinhlelo ezinkulu eziphumelelayo, njengohlelo lokugunyazwa kuzwelonke lwezikhungo zezempilo, ukuguqulwa kwedijithali kweNational Health Regulatory Authority, kanye nezinhlelo eziningana eziholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle nokwenza kahle emkhakheni wezempilo.

Iseshini yalo nyaka yoMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke izonquma ikusasa eliseduze nelisikhathi eside le-WHO, kusukela kwisabelomali sohlelo lweminyaka emibili ezayo, izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme kweNhlangano kanye nezinguquko ezenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo nokuziphendulela kwe-WHO.

Kuhlanganisa zonke izinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kanye/noma ngokomzwelo, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, ukunganakwa, ukunganaki kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezentengiselwano noma okunye, okuholela ekulimaleni kwangempela noma okungenzeka empilweni yengane, ukusinda, ukuthuthuka noma isithunzi esimweni sobudlelwano bomthwalo wemfanelo, ukwethembana noma amandla.

Ukuze babonise umoya wamalungu eKomiti Lezinqubomgomo Nokuxhumanisa (i-PCC) abagubha iminyaka engu-50 ye-HRP kanye nempumelelo yayo eminingi, iSweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland bafunda inothi elilandelayo lokubonga nokuhalalisela emhlanganweni wama-36 we-HRP PCC.

I-IPSN, enobuNobhala obubanjwe yi-WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ihlanganisa ndawonye ochwepheshe emhlabeni wonke abasezingeni eliphezulu kwezifundo ze-genomics kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha, abavela kohulumeni, izisekelo zokusiza abantu, izinhlangano zamazwe amaningi, umphakathi, izifundiswa kanye nomkhakha wangasese.

Zihlanganisa nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa, ukwenza lula izinqubo zokuthengwa kwempahla nokuhlinzekwa ukuze kubhekwane nanoma yikuphi ukungasebenzi kahle, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza ezifana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okuzinzile, ukuthuthukisa amakhono afanele abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye nokwandisa ukuqwashisa ngezinzuzo kanye nokulimala okungenzeka kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid.

Emphakathini, ukuvimbela i-sepsis kusizwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlanzeka eziphumelelayo, ukuthuthukisa ukuhlanzeka kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi nokutholakala kwawo, ukuhlinzeka ngemithi yokugoma, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasengozini enkulu, kanye nokudla okufanele, kubandakanya ukuncelisa ibele ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa.

Lezi zinhlelo zihlanganisa ithuluzi elenzelwe abantu asebekhulile, ukwakhiwa kwamakhono abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo abangu-2000, isonto lokukhuthaza impilo elenzelwe abantu asebekhulile, kanye nephrojekthi entsha yokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo nokuqonda kwabantu asebekhulile abangaphezu kwesigamu sesigidi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nasemaphandleni.

Lezi kanye nezikhwama zegazi ezingaba ngu-23 000 zilungiswa esikhungweni se-WHO sokuthutha impahla emhlabeni wonke e-International Humanitarian City, kanti i-WHO okwamanje ihlola wonke amathuba okuletha lezi zinsiza eSudan ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo waseSudan.

Ngaphezu komthelela omubi kagwayi empilweni, izindleko zomnotho eziphelele zokubhema (kusuka ezindlekweni zezempilo kanye nokulahleka komkhiqizo ndawonye) kulinganiselwa ukuthi zizungeze i-US $ 1.4 trillion ngonyaka, okulingana ngobukhulu no-1.8% womkhiqizo wasekhaya wonyaka (GDP) womhlaba.

Kulolu cwaningo olusha, amazwe ambalwa abike ukwehlisa ngenhloso ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amapulatifomu okuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kanye nemisebenzi ebalulekile yezempilo yomphakathi kusukela ekubikeni kuka-2020-2021, okukhombisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokubuyela emazingeni angaphambi kobhubhane wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo nokusebenza kohlelo olubanzi.

UDkt Balkhy unikeza ubuholi kwezobuchwepheshe nakwezombusazwe ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo wezempilo nowezomnotho wokumelana nezidakamizwa, kuhlanganise ngokubambisana kwemikhakha eminingi ne-Food and Agriculture Organization, i-World Organization for Animal Health, kanye ne-United Nations Environment Programme.

I-Benzathine penicillin (umthamo owodwa we-intramuscular) kumayunithi ayizigidi eziyi-0.6 (izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-10) namayunithi ayizigidi eziyi-1.2 (abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-10) angasetshenziselwa iziguli ezisolwa ngokwehluleka kokwelashwa komtholampilo ngemuva kwe-azithromycin, noma iziguli ezingakwazi ukwelashwa nge-azithromycin.

Leliqhinga ligxile kunoma yikuphi ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kulo lonke uhlelo lwezempilo; kusekelwe esimisweni sokunakekelwa okuhlanzekile nokuphephile njengengxenye ebalulekile yelungelo lempilo, eliqhutshwa ngokulingana, futhi okufanele liqinisekise ukuziphendulela nokusimama.

Ngokungeza amavithamini namaminerali abalulekile ekudleni okuyisisekelo nasezithasiselweni, njengofulawa kakolweni nommbila, ilayisi, uwoyela wokupheka nosawoti ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yokudla kanye nokuntuleka kwezakhamzimba, amazwe angalungisa futhi aqhubeke nokuvimbela ukuntuleka kwezakhamzimba ezincane.

Ngokuhambisana nezicelo zokuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezingqubuzanayo manje ziyeke ngokushesha ukulwa futhi zinciphise isimo esibangela ukuhlupheka okungachazeki kubantu baseSudan, i-UAE igxile ekuzibophezeleni kwayo ukuhlinzeka ngosizo nosizo emazweni ngezikhathi zobunzima.

Ukuhlanganiswa kwemikhakha: Ukukhuthaza imfundo kuwo wonke umjikelezo wokuphila; ukusekela ukutshalwa kwezimali okuhlakaniphile kwezomnotho, ngokuxhaswa ngemali okuhlangene emikhakheni ehlukene; ukuqinisa izimpendulo zokuzivumelanisa nesimo sezulu kuwo wonke umjikelezo wokuphila; nokuthuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuqina kwezinhlelo eziphuthumayo.

Manje, esikhundleni sokuthi impilo yabo bonke ibhekwe njengesikhonzi sokukhula komnotho, sinemephu yendlela yokwakha umsebenzi wezomnotho ngendlela ezosivumela ukuthi sifinyelele umgomo wokubona bonke abantu bethola izinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ngokushesha ngemiphumela engcono, "kusho uDkt Tedros.

Imigomo yalolu hlelo ihlanganisa ukunikeza izeluleko ezisebenzayo neziqondile ngemithelela yezempilo nezemvelo yokuchayeka emisebeni ye-UV, ukukhuthaza amazwe ukuba athathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa izingozi zezempilo ezibangelwa imisebe ye-UV nokunikeza iziphathimandla zikazwelonke isiqondiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa ngelanga.

Ukuphazamiseka okuqhubekayo kubangelwa yizici zombili ezivela ohlangothini lokufunwa nokunikezwa, okubandakanya amazinga aphansi okufuna ukunakekelwa kwezempilo emiphakathini kanye nokutholakala okulinganiselwe kwabasebenzi bezempilo nezinye izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezifana nemitholampilo evulekile noma izinqolobane zemithi nemikhiqizo etholakalayo.

I-World Health Assembly namuhla ivume isinqumo esingakaze sibe khona ngempilo yabantu bomdabu, esicela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuba athuthukise uhlelo lokusebenza lomhlaba wonke lwezempilo yabantu bomdabu futhi alethule eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi ayisikhombisa nesishiyagalolunye ngo-2026.

Izinselelo zokwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikamalaleveva ziye zaba nzima, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, ngenxa yobhadane lwe-COVID-19, ukuhlangana kwezinkinga zokusiza abantu, ukuncishiswa kwezimali, izinhlelo zokuqapha ezibuthakathaka, kanye nokwehla kokusebenza kwamathuluzi ayisisekelo okulwa nomalaleveva.

Le ngqungquthela iphinde yabonisa ukuzibophezela okuqondile kwe-SIDS ezindabeni ze-NCDs kanye nempilo yengqondo, okubandakanya ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo yengqondo ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo, ukuvuselela umthetho wokulawula ugwayi ukuze uhlanganise ugwayi we-e-cigarettes kanye ne-vaping, kanye nokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukasawoti noshukela kubantu.

Ngo-2021, amazwe angu-19 athola u-80% wezibophezelo. Umbiko uzokwethulwa kubantu abenza izinqumo eziphezulu emcimbini okhethekile wokwethulwa ngomhlaka-11 Julayi 2023 e-High-Level Political Forum (HLPF) on Sustainable Development, ngaphambi kwe-Summit yesibili ye-SDG ngoSepthemba 2023 eNew York.

Yukiko Nakatani, uMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO wezokwelapha nemikhiqizo yezempilo, uthi: "Ukushiya abantu behlupheka lapho kunemithi esebenzayo yokwelapha izinhlungu, ikakhulukazi esimweni sokunakekelwa kokuphela kokuphila, kufanele kube yimbangela yokukhathazeka okukhulu kwabenzi benqubomgomo".

Lona unyaka wesine womkhosi wamafilimu futhi umncintiswano wawunzima kakhulu, njengoba amafilimu angu-93 abhalwe ohlwini ahlanganisa izindaba ezisukela ekukhathazekeni nasekucindezelekeni kuya emiphumeleni yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu empilweni, kanye nezinselele zezempilo zabantu abakhubazekile.

Lezi ziqondiso zinikeza amazwe angamalungu, abalingani kanye nomphakathi ngezincomo ezisekelwe ebufakazini ezihlobene nendawo yokuhlala enganele (ukugcwala kwabantu), amazinga okushisa aphansi naphakeme endlini, izingozi zokulimala ekhaya, kanye nokufinyeleleka kwezindlu kubantu abanokukhubazeka kokusebenza.

Nakuba umkhakha wezokwelapha nomkhakha wezokuvakasha unganikeza usizo oluningi nezeluleko ezinengqondo, kusewumthwalo wemfanelo womhambi ukufuna ulwazi, ukuqonda izingozi ezihilelekile nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokuvikela impilo yakhe lapho ehamba.

Lesi sinqumo sinxusa amazwe angamalungu ukuba aqaphele indima yesayensi yokuziphatha ekufezeni imiphumela engcono yezempilo, ukukhomba amathuba okusetshenziswa okwengeziwe futhi, ukusungula imisebenzi namayunithi okukhiqiza nokuhumusha ubufakazi ukuze kusetshenziswe izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo.

Isinqumo soMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke sangoMeyi 2016 sasekela uhlelo lokuqala lwe-WHO Global Plan of Action lokuqinisa indima yohlelo lwezempilo ngaphakathi kwempendulo kazwelonke yemikhakha eminingi yokubhekana nodlame phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi olubhekiswe kwabesifazane namantombazane, kanye nezingane.

Lesi simemezelo siwumphumela oyinhloko weNgqungquthela yoNgqongqoshe be-SIDS ephathelene nezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo (NCDs) kanye nempilo yengqondo, eqhutshwa kusukela ngomhlaka-14 kuya ku-16 kuJuni, ehlelwe ngokubambisana yi-World Health Organization (WHO), i-Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) kanye noHulumeni waseBarbados.

Phakathi nesigaba sokuqala (i-syphilis eyinhloko), esihlala isikhathi esiyizinsuku ezingama-21 ngokwesilinganiso, kuvela isilonda esisodwa, esingenabuhlungu, esivame ukuba sinzima futhi esiyindilinga (i-chancre) endaweni yokugonywa (ukuxhumana), ngokuvamile esiswini, esifubeni noma emathunjini (kodwa futhi singaba ngaphandle kwezitho zangasese) futhi singase singabonwa.

Njengegunya eliqondisayo nelihlanganisa umsebenzi wezempilo wamazwe omhlaba, alikho iqabane elingcono kune-WHO ukuqhubekisela phambili umsebenzi esiwuqale e-EU nokuthuthukisa izixazululo zezempilo ezidijithali zomhlaba wonke", kusho uStella Kyriakides, uKhomishani Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kokudla.

Ngo-1996, eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wama-49, amazwe angamalungu anquma ukuba leli qoqo libhujiswe ngoJuni 1999, futhi avumele kuphela ukuba kugcinwe amasampula amancane ngezinjongo zocwaningo kumalabhorethri amabili agcinwe ngokuphepha - elilodwa e-United States nelinye eRussian Federation.

UDkt Asma uqondisa iphothifoliyo eqinisekisa ukuthi idatha yezempilo inokwethenjelwa futhi iyatholakala, futhi isetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni wonke, kufaka phakathi ukulandelela nokusheshisa inqubekela phambili ekufinyeleleni imigomo eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezintathu kanye nezinhloso zentuthuko ezinzile ezihlobene nezempilo.

Namuhla amazwe angamalungu amukele isayensi yokuziphatha ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezingcono zezempilo kanti amazwe angamalungu abonisa ukuvumelana okubanzi mayelana nesidingo sokuhlanganisa ngokuhlelekile imfundiso yesayensi yokuziphatha, izindlela kanye nezindlela ezihlobene nezindaba zezempilo kanye nemisebenzi yezempilo yomphakathi.

Ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zikhombisile ukuthi amazwe kudingeka akulungele ukubhekana nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo, anezinhlelo zokulungiselela ezilungiselelwe futhi anokuxhumana nokubambisana okungcono neminye imikhakha efana nezolimo.

I-WHO Pandemic Hub isebenza eduze namazwe angamalungu kanye namahhovisi esifunda nawamazwe e-WHO ukuze iqinise amakhono ayo okwabelana ngemininingwane futhi inike amandla abalingani abavela emhlabeni wonke ukuthi babambisane futhi bakhe amathuluzi okuqoqa nokuhlaziya idatha yokuqapha isexwayiso kusenesikhathi.

Le mininingwane iyavumelana naleyo yeKhomishini yeLancet ka-2018 eyachaza ukuntuleka kokutholakala kwemithi yokudambisa izinhlungu ngokuthi "enye yezinto ezimbi kakhulu, ezingalungile ezifihliwe empilweni yomhlaba wonke" kanti amaphesenti ayishumi kakhulu amazwe acebile anamaphesenti angu-90 emithi ye-opioid efanayo ne-morphine.

Okwesibili, i-HRP, ikakhulukazi nge-HRP Alliance, iqinise izikhungo zocwaningo endaweni nasemhlabeni jikelele, futhi, yenza abacwaningi abaningi bakwazi ukuthola amakhono ocwaningo aqinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwe-SRHR olusezingeni eliphezulu lungaqhubeka, futhi empeleni lukhule, esikhathini esizayo.

Ezinye izinhlobo zokungcola, njengomsindo, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi nenhlabathi, okubizwa ngokuthi iziqhingi ezishisayo zasemadolobheni, nokuntuleka kwendawo yokuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili nokuphila ngokuzikhandla, nakho kuhlangene ukwenza amadolobha abe yizikhungo zomqedazwe wezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo futhi abe yizimbangela zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu.

Emukela ababambiqhaza ekuqaleni kwengqungquthela yezinsuku ezimbili, uDkt Tedros uthe, "Lo mhlangano ubonisa ukuthi i-WHO iyini - abalingani abahlangana ndawonye ukuze basebenzise amandla abo ahlangene ukubhekana nezinselelo zezempilo zomhlaba wonke okungekho noyedwa kithi ongabhekana nazo eyedwa.

Ngenxa yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 oluqhubekayo kanye nosongo olungaba khona lomkhuhlane wezinyoni, le modyuli izovumela amazwe ukuba abukeze ngokucophelela, ahlole, futhi avuselele imizamo yawo yokuhlela ubhubhane lokuphefumula ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi anekhono lokusebenza.

Nokho, naphezu kokusetshenziswa kaningi kwezinto ezinikelwe ngabanikeli abashonile, iminikelo evela kubanikeli abaphilayo iyadingeka kwezinye izinhlobo zokufakelwa noma ukuze kulungiswe ukunikezwa okulinganiselwe kwezinto ezitholakala kubanikeli abashonile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeziguli.

NgoJuni 2023, i-WHO izosebenzisa uhlelo lwe-European Union (EU) lokuqinisekisa i-COVID-19 ngokwedijithali ukuze kusungulwe uhlelo lomhlaba wonke oluzosiza ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba komhlaba wonke futhi luvikele izakhamizi emhlabeni wonke ezinsongweni zezempilo eziqhubekayo nezesikhathi esizayo, kubandakanya nezifo eziwumshayabhuqe.

Izinqubomgomo ezinamandla zasemadolobheni kufanele zibeke phambili ezempilo, njengoba kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuphila ezinhle zasemadolobheni, ukwakha abasebenzi abakhiqizayo, ukudala imiphakathi enamandla futhi enempilo, ukunika amandla ukuhamba, ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana nomphakathi nokuvikela abantu abasengozini.

Ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eyathatha iminyaka eminingana, i-63rd World Health Assembly yamukela isinqumo i-WHA63.22 ngomhlaka-21 Meyi 2010, esekela izimiso eziqondisayo ze-WHO ezibuyekeziwe futhi ekhomba izindawo zokuthuthuka ukuze kwenziwe ngcono imikhuba yokunikela nokufakelwa.

Inhloso yale nethiwekhi entsha inamandla, kodwa futhi ingadlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikelekeni kwezempilo: ukunikeza wonke amazwe ukufinyelela ekuhlaziyweni nasekuhlaziyweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo njengengxenye yohlelo lwawo lwezempilo lomphakathi, kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Nakatani uzobheka ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuqaliswa kwezindinganiso nezinqubomgomo ze-WHO ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela okulinganayo emithini esezingeni eliphakeme, imithi yokugoma kanye nokuxilongwa kwazo zonke izakhamizi kuyo yonke indawo, kubandakanya nokuvimbela nokuphendula ezifweni eziwumshayabhuqe.

Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Farrar uzobheka uMnyango Wezesayensi, ahlanganise ochwepheshe abahamba phambili kanye namanethiwekhi kwezesayensi kanye nokwenza izinto ezintsha emhlabeni wonke ukuze aqondise, athuthukise futhi anikeze izinqubomgomo nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphakeme kubantu abazidinga kakhulu.
